messages:
Harper G: Quick postmortem follow-up we saw the multi-region routing flip happen again when cross-region snapshot restore lagged. Need a short actionable owner list and a 2-week cadence for fixes.
Omar S: Agreed. Propose splitting into: routing soft-fallback, snapshot idempotency, cache-warm preflight, and runbook automation.
Liang W: I'll take snapshot idempotency + replication validation. Plan: run full restores to an isolated cluster and simulate 200ms+ latency with tc. Attach RTO/RPO numbers. ETA 5 days.
Harper G: Good. Omar, can you own routing soft-fallback + canary policy? Need terraform diff + small rollout pipeline.
Omar S: Yes. Canary plan suggestion: immediate soft-shift 15% to backup, wait 10m, if health OK -> 50% after 30m -> full after 2h. Add forced rollback if 5xx rate > 1.2% or kv_hit_rate < 75%.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-11-08 09:00 UTC "DR: canary smoke"
sre-bot: Reminder created and added to #incidents calendar.
Liang W: For snapshot idempotency I'll add UUIDs to writes and checksum verification. Also will include a replay of control-plane retries to ensure dedupe.
Harper G: Cache-warm preflight owner? We keep hitting cold-KV storms during the shift. Need a primer + validation step in runbook.
Omar S: I'll write the priming script. Snippet for runbook: ```bash
# prime top keys in us-west
python prime_kv.py --region us-west --top 7000 --concurrency 16
python kv_check.py --region us-west --window 300 --min-hit 0.8
```
Liang W: I'll run restore tests under packet loss (1%/2%) and attach results to INFR-1501.
Harper G: I'll consolidate items into the remediation tracker and create INFR-1501 with subtasks for each owner. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-1501
Omar S: One more: add a telemetry gating step so the canary won't progress if metrics are stale >60s. I'll add that gate to the pipeline.
Harper G: Deadlines: owners post checklists by Tue EOD, restore artifacts Wed, priming script Fri, game-day rehearsal next Tue. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you've posted?
Liang W: :white_check_mark:
Omar S: :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: Note: game-day scheduled 2024-11-12 15:00 UTC; calendar invite created.
eng-oncall-bot: Ping sent to ENG-ONCALL rotation for rehearsal week.
Harper G: Thanks team. I'll send a 2-paragraph summary to SRE leads and reopen thread if any ETA slips.
